input.change_text: Improved \`Ctrl+C\` detection prevents accidental exits when canceling agent runsin CLI.

output.subject: Cursor CLI Ctrl+C no longer exits when cancelling an agent run
output.action_text: Upgrade Cursor CLI to 2-4+ if `Ctrl+C` was killing your shell session when you meant to cancel an in-flight agent run. The single-press cancel-vs-exit distinction is now disambiguated; existing hotkey muscle memory is preserved.
